svg.text: Common DC link of the crane drives – energy exchange, braking resistor or regenerative supply
electrical power (kW) – move 18.8 m out, 5.8 m down, full load
hoist lowering = generator all the time
DC link sum: hoist energy feeds the travel
kinetic energy travel ½·m·v² = ½·4 500·3² = 20 250 J = 5.6 Wh
lowering 1 150 kg by 5 m: m·g·h = 56 400 J = 15.7 Wh
peak regenerative power ≈ m·g·v ≈ 11 kW (hoist down)
FEM dual cycle: 33 Wh with resistor, 11.5 Wh with regen
braking resistor: cheap, heat in the cabinet / aisle
regen / AFE supply: energy back to the grid, clean current
capacitor storage module: peak shaving, lower connection
power, ride-through for a controlled stop at power loss
EXAMPLE – check the AS/RS supplier's documentation
